description:
All tree entries are rendered as plain text. Upstream applies ANSI colors to every part of a tree entry line.

## Current Elixir behavior (tree_selector.ex render_node)

`render_node/4` in `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/components/tree_selector.ex` produces plain text only:
- Cursor: plain `"› "` or `"  "`
- Prefix (tree connectors): plain `"├─ "`, `"│  "`, etc.
- Path marker: plain `"• "`
- Labels: plain `"[label] "`
- Role/content: plain text, e.g. `"user: hello"`
- Selected row: no background highlight

## Expected upstream styling (tree-selector.ts render())

Every part of the line is styled:
| Element | Style |
|---------|-------|
| Cursor `"› "` | `theme.fg("accent", "› ")` |
| No-cursor `"  "` | plain |
| Tree prefix (connectors/gutters) | `theme.fg("dim", prefix)` |
| Active path marker `"• "` | `theme.fg("accent", "• ")` |
| Label `"[label] "` | `theme.fg("warning", "[label] ")` |
| Label timestamp | `theme.fg("muted", "HH:MM ")` |
| Entry text when selected | `theme.bold(result)` |
| Entire selected row | `theme.bg("selectedBg", line)` |
| `"user: "` prefix | `theme.fg("accent", "user: ")` |
| `"assistant: "` prefix | `theme.fg("success", "assistant: ")` |
| Tool result text | `theme.fg("muted", ...)` |
| bash entry | `theme.fg("dim", ...)` |
| Compaction | `theme.fg("borderAccent", ...)` |
| Branch summary prefix | `theme.fg("warning", "[branch summary]: ")` |
| model/thinking/custom/label entries | `theme.fg("dim", ...)` |
| Session info title name | `theme.fg("dim", ...)` |

## Where to fix

`apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/components/tree_selector.ex` — `render_node/4` and `entry_display_text/1`.

The docstring says 'No ANSI escape codes — suitable for snapshot testing.' This is intentional for the pure render layer. The colors need to be applied in the TUI render wrapper, i.e. `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex` — `render/2`, which calls `Tree.render_lines/2`. Options:
1. Add an `ansi: true` option to `render_lines/2` that enables styled output (keeps tests using plain version)
2. Move rendering to TUI layer and add theme wrapping there

Verify by opening /tree in tmux and confirming: cursor is accent-colored, selection has a background, path markers are accent, tree connectors are dim, role prefixes have correct colors.

## Key upstream function references
- `render()` lines 602-688 in tree-selector.ts
- `getEntryDisplayText()` lines 690-790 in tree-selector.ts
